description: Install Voicedot in an authorized website, review page feedback and team handovers, reply with confirmation, and prepare human review rounds.

interface.longDescription: Connect Voicedot to work from feedback left on your website. Find authorized projects, read pinned conversations with their page context and replies, and inspect the work your team handed to an agent. Private addresses expose conversations directly; Team and Public addresses expose only handed-over conversations. Prepare review rounds so a person can check the changes on the page. With separately granted permissions, create projects, add site addresses, obtain installation instructions, close page pins, resolve discussions, or reply after an exact preview and explicit confirmation. A coding agent installs the snippet using its own authorized repository tools and verifies a fresh backend ping. New-account setup is also available through the official Voicedot CLI outside this MCP connection, with human identity verification. The first feedback message and final review decisions remain with the person. The plugin cannot delete feedback, access projects outside the connection grant, or perform purchases.
defaultPrompt: What feedback is still open in my Voicedot project?
Show the conversation about this button, including the replies.
What did my team hand over to me, and what is left to check?

positive.description: List the two projects in the dedicated demo account.
positive.prompt: Which Voicedot projects do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: List Harbor Notes and Fieldwork Notes, and no projects outside the current grant.

positive.description: Inspect open Harbor Notes feedback without changing it.
positive.prompt: What feedback is still open on Harbor Notes?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize the headline, button contrast, card picture, quote logo, and phone spacing. The closed Help conversation is excluded.

positive.description: Read the button conversation and its replies.
positive.prompt: Show me the conversation about the Start a workspace button, with the replies.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the original contrast note, its page context, and the team reply about making the button darker, in chronological order.

positive.description: Read the conversation explicitly handed to an agent in Team mode.
positive.prompt: What did my team hand over to you in Fieldwork Notes?
positive.expected_behavior: Show the offline-headline conversation and team note requesting a headline under eight words. Do not expose the other conversation, which has not been handed over.

positive.description: Inspect the open human review round.
positive.prompt: Show the open review round in Harbor Notes and what is left to check.
positive.expected_behavior: Show Homepage fixes, with the Start a workspace button checked and the headline still awaiting human review. Do not check either item as the agent.

negative.description: The request is outside Voicedot; answer without calling its tools.
Deletion is unsupported. Do not replace it with closure or resolution; closure needs a separate explicit request.
negative.prompt: Delete the comment about the Help link.

negative.description: Do not disclose feedback outside the current connection grant.
negative.prompt: Show me the feedback of another company's Voicedot project.

publication.release_notes: 0.4.0 aligns the package with the current 29-tool MCP contract and knowledge version 2026-10-20.1. Adds project addresses, team handovers and human review rounds to the skill, documents official CLI account setup separately from MCP, corrects tool annotations and reply retry behavior, and replaces review cases with Harbor Notes and Fieldwork Notes. No commerce.
